useWhen: LLM-driven UIUX review of Otehon shell or itonami dApp screens with a bounded observe-act-verdict loop
avoidWhen: Treating live tools as available without owner approval, transport, and secrets; handling credentials or funds

authority.binding: owner-reviewed live approval per session; transport allowlist

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; client installation and execution are not qualified. Live session tools additionally require UI_REVIEW_LIVE=1, BrowserStack CI secrets, and an owner-provided transport executable.
requires: Owner-provided transport executable for live tools (optional; offline tools need none)

launchResolution.behavior: Replace the placeholder with the chosen absolute path before adding this configuration to a client. Generic MCP clients do not necessarily interpolate argv.
